title: French Deputies Reject Revenue Portion of 2027 Budget in Committee
detail: French deputies in the finance committee broadly rejected the revenue ('recettes') portion of the 2027 budget. The full text will be debated on the floor of the National Assembly beginning Tuesday, setting up a contentious legislative battle over fiscal policy.

title: French Left-Wing Primary Draws 140,000+ Voters, Outcome Uncertain
detail: The French left-wing primary to select a presidential candidate drew more than 140,000 voters, with the outcome proving more uncertain than initially anticipated. The primary reflects ongoing efforts by France's fractured left to unite behind a single candidate ahead of the next presidential election.

title: France Promises 3,000 Extra Teachers to Calm Mass Student Protests
detail: The French government promised 3,000 additional teachers as a first concession to calm mass student protests sweeping the country. Demonstrators and analysts say the movement exposes deeper structural inequalities by race and class.
